Purpose: Preserve the complete approved 198-module scope and explicit per-module role review. Review is not proof of full implementation or acceptance.

OpenQuestions.Question: Whether to expose raw AES blocks and standalone Poly1305 in cryptoAdvanced or retain them as AEAD internals.

asn1.Reason: 完整 DER 值、独立 reader/builder 与拥有式字节；裸视图、长度预检及输出指针封闭在驻留实现中。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
asn1.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

pem.Reason: 完整块和多块读取；直接使用有界输出与语言拥有数据，不再导出返回原生分配指针的 EncodeNew/DecodeNew 便利函数。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
pem.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

crypto-core.Reason: 公开长度、等长内容的原生比较和共享摘要枚举；内部擦除／清理不构成新的语言内存 API。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
crypto-core.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

crypto-internal-arithmetic.Reason: 这些模块没有独立 C 公共函数，提供原生大整数、曲线及通用参数化签名／验证／随机支撑；由明确命名的曲线／密钥入口复用，不另造语言数学或裸状态对象。
crypto-internal-arithmetic.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

rsa-owners.Reason: 完整 n/e/d 或完整 CRT 组件、独立 bytes、原生盲化及 checked 错误；不伪造缺失 CRT，不声称 keygen/OAEP。
rsa-owners.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

rsa-pss.Reason: 显式摘要、MGF 与完整盐；默认严格、任意盐显式分名；保留安全随机及盲化，不误标私钥计算为 pure/nonblocking。
rsa-pss.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

rsa-pkcs1.Reason: 明确是完整摘要的 PKCS1 v1.5 签名／验证，不是加密；RsaHash 选择算法，拥有式原始签名保留 checked 错误。
rsa-pkcs1.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

ecdsa-der.Reason: 规范 raw r||s 与 DER 转换独立裁剪，不为编码引入曲线对象、签名、验证或 RNG。
ecdsa-der.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

nist-keys.Reason: 明确曲线的完整私钥、公钥、ECDH 和高级点操作，独立 bytes 与真实 resident leaf，不增加泛型曲线猜测。
nist-keys.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

nist-keypair.Reason: 原生 OS 安全随机创建既有受管理密钥；分别裁剪，不返回 HEX／字典，不新增密钥生命周期。
nist-keypair.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

ecdsa-operations.Reason: SignatureHash 明确 RFC6979 摘要选择，原生 low-S 与定宽签名；精确验证拒绝和 checked 错误区分，不猜曲线。
ecdsa-operations.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

ecdsa-operations_der.Reason: DER 签名／验证独立命名，签名只执行一次并在有界暂存中输出；不混用 raw 编码。
ecdsa-operations_der.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

digests.Reason: 有界消息与完整二字段 string/bytes，拥有式输出和独立流快照；遗留摘要放 cryptoLegacy。SHA384 属于原生 SHA512 模块，没有遗漏。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
digests.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

hmac.Reason: 完整 key 与有界消息分离；复用原生一次性和流式算法，快照、独立 clone/reset 与状态擦除不暴露指针。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
hmac.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

kdf.Reason: 完整密码、IKM、salt、info；显式迭代／输出预算、HKDF 255 块边界，PBKDF2 不误标 nonblocking；SHA384 与 SHA512 共享原生模块。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
kdf.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

chacha20-advanced.Reason: 显式 raw 流密码，不是 AEAD；完整 key/nonce、字节前缀、无回绕 uint32 计数器，旧断链 HEX 包装已退出。
chacha20-advanced.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

aes-gcm.Reason: 缓存不可变展开密钥，固定已批准的 12-byte nonce/16-byte tag 与 cipher||tag；分离输出指针的 Encrypt/Decrypt 不另导出。GMAC 由空消息 seal 和 AAD 组合，不重造算法。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
aes-gcm.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

chacha-aead.Reason: 完整 key/nonce、独立消息/AAD 前缀、cipher||tag，认证成功才交付拥有式明文；Seal/Open 覆盖分离输出指针的 Encrypt/Decrypt 便利函数。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
chacha-aead.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

xdh-keys.Reason: 完整私钥复制、缓存公钥、独立共享秘密与显式 raw；统一受管理叶，不公开 HEX／字典或可见借用。
xdh-keys.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

ed25519.Reason: 完整 seed 复制和缓存展开密钥；pure/context/prehash 分名。统一用原生 Ex 模式，SignKey/Verify 的 pure 便利函数无需重复导出；typed 错误分类不吞 OOM。
ed25519.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

ed25519-keypair.Reason: OS SecureRandom 加一次 KeyInit，生成同一受管理类型；避免先 KeyPair 派生公钥、再由 KeyInit 重复派生。
ed25519-keypair.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

xdh-keypair.Reason: 原生安全随机直接创建已有受管理类型；方法及格式复用，不增加裸指针结果或平行拥有权。
xdh-keypair.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected ordinary public-product cases; role review is not full semantic, race, cryptographic-security or goal acceptance

atomic.Reason: 显式 concurrent 的五种定宽对象；保留精确 CAS 与内存顺序，不公开裸原子地址。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
atomic.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

spin.Reason: 只作 Channel 等运行时内部同步；批准方案不增加公开 SpinLock。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
spin.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

channel.Reason: 统一 typed 消息、取消和原子选择；异步等待使用拥有式 Future 订阅，不复制一套队列。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
channel.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

native-coroutines.Reason: 批准方案不公开七个有栈协程模块；语言使用 XLIR 帧与固定工作线程＋就绪队列，不增加第二套执行模型。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
native-coroutines.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

wait.Reason: 等待保留值和代码租约；不向语言公开原生短生命周期 waiter 指针。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
wait.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

once.Reason: 成功执行一次，false/异常可重试；不保留无关回调或新增初始化引擎。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
once.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

event.Reason: 自动／手动复位与 checked 期限；复用 Sync 生命周期和可恢复退役。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
event.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

thread-local.Reason: typed TLS 槽拥有值与模块租约，原生 thread key 不交给语言。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
thread-local.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

thread.Reason: 显式线程与拥有式语言回调；不把每次 await 映射为系统线程。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
thread.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

sync-base.Reason: 原生 Sync 资源与 checked 退役基础；不再暴露一套可互换的裸句柄。

sync.Reason: 保留手动解锁及既定等待语义；活动操作有 pin，清理失败可由宿主 checked 恢复，不 abort。

sync.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

cancel.Reason: 保留父取消、可追踪回调及 checked 生命周期；取消请求不冒称物理清理已完成。

cancel.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance

future.Reason: typed 生产端、值桥接、继续与聚合属于语言 Future 模型；原生 FutureBridge 不作为第二个语言对象导出。
DecisionWitnesses: docs/并发与安全标准库接入.md
future.AcceptanceBoundary: Selected normal product cases; not full semantic, race or goal acceptance
